units.source_text: 我站起身来，鸟瞰远方山洞的金阁。

en.t: I stood up and looked down at the Golden Pavilion in the distant mountain hollow.

units.source_text: 从那里传出了异样的声音，像是爆竹的声音，也像是无数的人的关节一齐响起的声音。

en.t: From there came a strange sound, like firecrackers, and also like the joints of countless people cracking all at once.
